tasks.title: Set up project structure and dependencies
tasks.description: Initialize project with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and necessary dependencies. Set up package.json with required libraries.

tasks.title: Create landing page with personal info form
tasks.description: Build the landing page with form fields for Name, Phone Number, and Agent Name. Include Start Quiz button.
acceptanceCriteria: Form has Name, Phone Number, and Agent Name fields
Form validation ensures all fields are completed
Page is responsive on desktop and mobile

tasks.title: Create quiz question database
tasks.description: Set up master question set with 51 MCQs and 9 essay questions. Each question should have an ID, text, type, and score value.
acceptanceCriteria: 51 MCQs are defined with correct answers
Each question has score value assigned
Questions are stored in accessible format

tasks.title: Implement question randomization logic
tasks.description: Create logic to randomly select 28 MCQs and always include 2 essay questions at the end for each user.
acceptanceCriteria: 28 MCQs are randomly selected per user
2 essay questions are always at the end

tasks.title: Build quiz page UI with question display
tasks.description: Create quiz page that displays questions one by one or all at once. Include answer selection interface for MCQs and text input for essays.
acceptanceCriteria: Essay questions have text input fields
UI is responsive on desktop and mobile

tasks.title: Implement countdown timer (20 minutes)
tasks.description: Create a countdown timer that starts at 20 minutes and prevents quiz submission after time expires.
acceptanceCriteria: Submission is prevented after time expires
User is notified when time is up

tasks.title: Implement score calculation logic
tasks.description: Create logic to calculate total score based on user answers. MCQs = 1 point each, Essay questions = 5 points each.
acceptanceCriteria: MCQ answers are scored at 1 point each
Essay answers are scored at 5 points each

tasks.title: Set up Google Sheets integration
tasks.description: Configure Google Apps Script or serverless function to receive quiz data and save to Google Sheet. Set up authentication and API keys.

tasks.title: Create Google Sheet structure
tasks.description: Set up Google Sheet with columns for Timestamp, Name, Phone, Agent Name, Q1-Q30 Answers, and Total Score.

tasks.title: Implement quiz submission functionality
tasks.description: Create submit button and logic to send quiz data (user info, answers, score) to backend/Google Sheets.

tasks.title: Create results page with score summary
tasks.description: Build results page that displays only the total score summary. Do not show individual answers or correct answers.

tasks.title: Implement data persistence to Google Sheets
tasks.description: Create backend function to receive quiz data and save it to Google Sheet with timestamp and all required fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Data is saved to Google Sheet

tasks.title: Ensure responsive design for mobile and desktop
tasks.description: Test and optimize UI for desktop and mobile devices. Ensure all elements are accessible and functional on different screen sizes.
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons and inputs are accessible

tasks.title: Implement answer hiding mechanism
tasks.description: Ensure users cannot view correct answers or their individual answers after submission. Only show total score.
acceptanceCriteria: Correct answers are not accessible to users

tasks.title: Testing and QA
tasks.description: Perform comprehensive testing including functionality, responsiveness, data accuracy, and edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer works and prevents late submission
Data is saved correctly to Google Sheet
UI is responsive on all devices
No answers are revealed to users
